description: Every cell editor SvGrid ships, in one Svelte 5 grid modelled on an annual vendor review. Each column sets an editorType: text, number with currency formatting, date, checkbox, list, chips with editorMultiple, color and rating. Columns whose raw value would look bland add a cell snippet for the read-only display (tier chip, category tags, brand swatch, 5-star rating, mood, delivery progress bar, status badge, owner avatar), so every column stays editable while looking finished.
keywords: svelte data grid date picker cell

faq.question: How do I pick the editor for a column?
faq.answer: Set editorType on the column definition: text, number, date, checkbox, list, chips, color or rating. list and chips take their choices from editorOptions, and chips sets editorMultiple so a cell can hold several values.

faq.question: How do I render a custom display without losing the editor?
faq.answer: Keep the editorType and add a cell function that returns a snippet, as the tier, status and rating columns do here with renderSnippet. The snippet draws the read-only view; double-click or F2 still opens the built-in editor for that type.

faq.question: How is the currency column formatted?
faq.answer: Through the column format setting: { type: "currency", currency: "USD" } with Intl options such as maximumFractionDigits. The date column uses format { type: "date", pattern: "y-m-d" } the same way.
